name: SecOps Dash
shortDescription: Offline security-operations triage: events, incidents, timelines and manual response playbooks.
features: Offline ingest from local fixtures with per-row validation reasons (nothing dropped silently)
Asset-criticality-weighted incident scoring (transparent formula shown in-product)
Incident timeline with collection timestamps + provenance page
Category-mapped response playbooks — explicit manual runbook steps (no automated containment)
Status machine (new→triaged→contained→closed) as human decisions; JSON export with integrity note
knownLimitations: Simulated demo data; in-memory incident state resets on restart
No live telemetry connectors by design (offline-first)
